pages.comment: THE LEAD MAGNET, moved into this registry 22 Oct 2026. It shipped on 8 Oct as a hand-committed index.html that was in NO registry, and the cost of that was exactly what you would predict and nobody saw: it was absent from sitemap.xml (which is generated from this file), no page linked to it, and it had already drifted a shared script behind every generated page. A free offer reachable only by typing its URL is not an offer. inLineNav is false on purpose — it is not a fourth audience alongside SNF/home health/hospice — so its only paths in are the two crosslinks added to the facilities hub and the mid-stay page, plus the sitemap. verify.mjs now fails if a built page is missing from the sitemap, which is the check that would have caught this on day one.
